title: holding_value summary.json data (v1)
description: Holding-company NAV discount. 'pairs' is the FULL list in config.json order (current.json pseudo-rows such as '_average' are excluded; averageRatio carries it), so the hub derives both the TOP card (ratio desc) and per-code lookups (first pair whose code matches). Money is in 억원 as in current.json.

code.description: Holding company stock code (6 chars, no .KS suffix).

ratio.description: Holding value / adjusted market cap, %. Higher = deeper discount.

ratioPct1y.description: Optional. Share of samples at or below the current ratio in the trailing 365 days ending at ratioPctEnd (dashboard chip rule: integer, at least 30 samples, else null).

ratioPct3y.description: Optional. Same for 1,095 days. The older part of the window is weekly-downsampled, so it is an approximation.

ratioPctEnd.description: Optional. Last date of the daily distribution. It can lag envelope asOf when the daily job fails; the current ratio is always the snapshot value.
